title: Adding a user index writes PSINDEXDEFN (INDEXTYPE 4) and one PSKEYDEFN per key, and raises PSRECDEFN.INDEXCOUNT at the new RDM
statement: Add Index on an SQL Table in App Designer writes one PSINDEXDEFN row with INDEXTYPE 4 (user index), its unique / cluster / active / custom-order flags, and one PSKEYDEFN row per key field (KEYPOSN, ASCDESC); PSRECDEFN.INDEXCOUNT goes up by one and VERSION becomes the new RDM; RDM and SYS +1. One capture.

observations.observation: Capture ix01-native-user-index-add (record-rows.json): PSINDEXDEFN index A, INDEXTYPE 4, UNIQUEFLAG 0, CLUSTERFLAG 0, ACTIVEFLAG 1, CUSTKEYORDER 1; PSKEYDEFN KEYPOSN 1 and 2, ASCDESC 1; INDEXCOUNT 1 -> 2; VERSION 387 -> 388 = RDM after.
